Recommend DA commitment for POTEETS while maintaining close watch on POT_OAKS_1 rebinding: if that constraint re-fires at HE17–HE19 today, any residual RT discharge capacity will capture outsized locational premiums.

**22 nodes:** CATARINA_B1, CEDRVALE_RN, COYOTSPR_RN, FALFUR_RN, FAULKNER_RN, FTDUNCAN_RN, GOMZ_RN, GRDNE_ESR_RN, HAMI_BESS_RN, HOLCOMB_RN1, JDKNS_RN, LONESTAR_RN, MNWL_BESS_RN, MV_VALV4_RN, OLNEYTN_RN, RTLSNAKE_BT, RUSSEKST_RN, SADLBACK_RN, SANDLAKE_RN, SBEAN_BESS, TOYAH_RN, WLTC_ESR_RN
